title: Follower shadow camera fixes
description: The camera setups (res/field/cameras/defaults.json, by index) whose buffering, near plane or actors' clip Z offset Paper White 2 changes so the engine's oval stays under the follower's feet (docs/paperwhite2/following-pokemon.md, Camera-side fixes; tools/paperwhite2/camera_audit.py derives them). tools/paperwhite2/following_camera_fixes.py checks the file and writes it into paperwhite2/following_camera_fixes_config.h for src/paperwhite2/ov036/paperwhite2_following_render.c. A setup not listed keeps its vanilla camera; deleting an entry reverts that setup alone.

fixes.description: One entry a setup, in any order, each setup once

setup.description: The camera setup's index in res/field/cameras/defaults.json

zones.description: Where the setup is, for the reader (the zones whose headers name it)

z_buffer.description: Z-buffer a W-buffered setup, so the actors' clip Z offset counts there

near.description: The near plane in units, replacing the setup's, for the Z-buffer's precision; null keeps the setup's

scale_offset.description: Multiply the actors' clip Z offset (and the effects' half) by the near plane in units, which gives the ordinary maps' depth between a body and its oval at any near plane

w_pull.description: For a setup that stays W-buffered, variant 14a: the actors' pass (every field actor's body, as the clip Z offset reaches on ordinary maps) moved nearer the camera along the eye rays by this fraction of their distance, their pictures unchanged; the effects stay. Built in with w_pull_built_in, else the debug menu's 14a only (every setup's is built in now). Absent or null for none

w_pull_built_in.description: The w_pull always on (tested), rather than the debug menu's 14a only. Absent for false

low_oval.description: The follower's oval lowered to a quarter of a unit over the ground (the engine's is a unit), which needs a smaller w_pull. Absent for false

offset_scale.description: For a Z-buffered setup with scale_offset: the factor on the scaled clip Z offset (near plane times it), the smallest that keeps the follower's oval off its body. Absent for 1
